verdict.rationale: Docs mention AI agents that can 'trigger workflows' and update records in response to chat, implying some automation capability, but there is no documentation of a dedicated rules/trigger system (e.g., event-based triggers, conditions, or scheduled automations) that a user can configure declaratively. Missing for 10: explicit rule-definition UI/API, event trigger types (webhooks, schedules, data changes), and independent verification that automation runs without a chat prompt.
